name: Cleanup Mesh
explanation_long: Cleans up a model by recomputing mesh normals, removing duplicate vertices and optionally correcting the winding order or merging vertices by distance.
explanation: Cleans up a model by recomputing mesh normals, removing duplicate vertices and optionally correcting the winding order or merging vertices by distance.

exposed_options.name: Recompute Input Normals
exposed_options.description: Discards the original normals and recomputes them. This can help with flipped, broken or inconvenient input normals.

exposed_options.name: Normal Hard Angle Threshold
exposed_options.description: Hard threshold (degrees) used for normal generation (0 = everything flat, 180 = everything smooth).

exposed_options.name: Normal Computation Method
exposed_options.description: Weighting method for mesh normals. Angle works well for most surfaces, whereas Area works (face-weighted normals) especially well when a model has bevels or fillets.

exposed_options.name: Vertex Merging Distance
exposed_options.description: Distance in Percentage relative to the overall models bounding box size for Vertex Merging.

exposed_options.name: Prevent cross-mesh vertex merging
exposed_options.description: Decides if vertex merging should run on a per mesh basis. This avoids merging vertices from different separate meshes.

exposed_options.name: Fix Winding Order
exposed_options.description: Automatically fix the winding order of parts on import.
